limitations: No arbitrary global distributed transaction or general exactly-once guarantee
Advanced protocols, CDC/SCD/Fuzzy and BI Planner remain outside the current core acceptance
Single-session container transactions; arbitrary resource combinations and transactional child checkpoints are rejected before effects
Query/Schema enumerators have no reproducible external snapshot token and reject checkpoint resume
Recovery plans serialize tree scheduling; operator partitions merge in deterministic partition order
Source ranges and round-robin partitions are stable logical row positions; file partitions scan the authorized immutable source instead of assuming record-safe byte offsets
Driver/external RSS is outside the native allocator quota; benchmark RSS is measured separately
Advanced SSIS components and BI Planner remain their existing Planned/Partial status; all 69 goals are retained
Pool reuse requires UD_CONNECT_POOL and a successful native reset_session; unknown third-party session state is closed instead of reused
PostgreSQL module requires libpq >=17 for nonblocking cancellation; tested against a disposable local server, without production connections
Float64 SUM preserves serial input order and reports effective partition count 1; integer/Decimal SUM uses exact private 256-bit partial state and checks the public range only at final output
Runtime task/pipeline diagnostic records are bounded at 1024/256 and report dropped counts; callback events remain the complete optional host stream
Windows is exempt by explicit user instruction; no Windows compilation, runtime or binary certification is claimed
Execution caches require one builder and do not publish from an active transaction; cross-execution reuse is not implicit.
Incremental confirmation is a whole-DataFlow receipt barrier; active-transaction incremental sources are explicitly Unsupported.
Canonical SQLite exact NUMERIC/Decimal and PostgreSQL unbounded numeric or timestamp without time zone require a supported declared domain instead of guessed conversions.
Immutable journal Wire payloads remain owned by the state directory through resume; the host retires that directory after retention requirements are met.
ABI 7 row identity/rule metadata increases sort spill traffic. The matching CSV workload regressed against the historical ABI 6 baseline; six workload results do not imply a universal speedup.
